description: This source file defines a Java interface 'ModifyFeaturePropertyLiveCommand' within the package 'org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.live.modify'. The interface extends several other interfaces and provides method signatures for accessing properties related to a live command that modifies a feature property. It serves as part of a larger system managing signal commands in the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically handling modification of feature properties via JSON pointers and values.

methods.name: getPropertyPointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer of the Property to modify.

methods.name: getPropertyValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the Property to modify.
